en.title: Building a Databricks Data Lakehouse on AWS: Unity Catalog to Production
en.description: End-to-end course for building and operating a production Databricks Lakehouse deployed on AWS — Unity Catalog governance, Delta Lake (ACID, CDF, liquid clustering), Auto Loader and Structured Streaming ingestion, Databricks Runtime/Photon transformation, Lakeflow/DLT pipelines, Databricks SQL serverless warehouses and Lakeview, workflows-as-code with asset bundles, data quality expectations, Delta Sharing and Marketplace, performance and DBU cost optimization, CI/CD with Terraform, and a full capstone reference architecture — with architecture diagrams, real customer cases, worked pricing examples, and practice questions.
